content:
mira: Quick check — can we enable the autoscale feature-flag for a small canary? Want to validate burst + queue behavior under transient spikes. Target = 5% traffic (team-alpha). Running ~1h smoke -> soak.

alex: +1 to testing but prefer soft_max_concurrency=150 instead of 200 to reduce overload risk. Also set cooldown to 120s.

sam: FYI avoid instant scale-downs — agree with 120s cooldown. Also set `burst_window_sec`=45 to keep bursts bounded.

mira: Proposed flag payload: 
```
flags:
  enable_burst: true
  burst_window_sec: 45
  soft_max_concurrency: 150
  queueing_policy: "fifo_fair"
  autoscale_cooldown_sec: 120
  fallback_model: "model-small"
```
Run command: `/feature-flag toggle enable_burst true --scope canary --audience team-alpha --note "burst/queue smoke test"`

jamie: Add me to the watch list for rollback. I'll monitor p95 latency, error-rate, 429s, queue_length, and GPU util. If p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows or 429 rate > 0.5% revert immediately. :warning:

mira: Got it — patching rollout policy to include automatic fallback to `model-small` on >=0.5% 429s for 2m. Canary window: 60m (30m smoke + 30m soak).

alex: Also add a soft cap override in infra, not just flag: `max_concurrency_guardrail=150` so any downstream config honors the intent.

sam: One more: set queue_length_threshold=100 to start shedding and trigger fallback earlier.

mira: I'll schedule toggle for 2026-03-18T15:30:00Z and post updates in #incidents if anything weird. @jamie @alex @sam please ack if you can watch the metrics during the window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag change: enable_burst=true (scope=canary, audience=team-alpha) at 2026-03-18T15:30:00Z by mira. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/flags/1837654321

alex: ack :thumbsup:

jamie: ack, I'll be on call for the window.

sam: ack, monitoring dashboards up.

mira: thanks everyone — will post quick post-mortem + perf numbers after soak.
